decisions.title: 2025 Downtown Albuquerque Parking Study (EC-26-175)
decisions.description: Establishes Downtown 2050's parking implementation strategy through supply, occupancy, and demand analysis plus recommendations for pricing, shared parking, benefit districts, multimodal travel, wayfinding, safety, and redevelopment.
